authorization.request: Store gives compatibility advice; DSH Desktop performs final installation checks and reports the result.

gates: Only approved Catalog entries with immutable Git Commits, safe paths, matching manifests, and Commit publication evidence enter native Discover.
Compatibility evidence is advice; the index does not pre-filter unknown DSH versions or impose Store-generated engines.dsh ranges.
Native index labels disclose DSH final checks and any Store compatibility recheck recommendation.
Run npm run check before committing; CI must run the typed plan, official parser, and exact-head checks before merge.
Merge only through the auditable PR after deterministic checks pass, then verify GitHub Raw, Pages, dsh.store, and dsh-store.cn.
Do not claim real Desktop acceptance from source checks; do not change a real Profile or DSH source.
rollback: Revert the exact source PR through a CI-checked PR. Production keeps the prior artifact until the atomic storefront refresh and health checks pass; no real Profile is changed.
healthCheck: Verify the typed plan and npm run check locally, official parser and exact-head CI on the PR, then independently read back GitHub Raw, Pages, dsh.store, and dsh-store.cn.

verdict.nativeIndexProjection: 33 approved entries published; 30 carry the Store compatibility recheck label; no Store-generated engines.dsh constraints
verdict.staticBuild: STATIC_MARKETPLACE_OK; native index format=1, entries=33, review labels=30, version fields omit Store-generated engines.dsh
verdict.officialDshParser: not run locally; required in PR CI before merge
verdict.realDesktop: not tested; no real Profile was changed

boundaries: No DSH source or @deepseek-ai package changes.
